say:1:1422692001:1.text: Did it work? She's not regenerating...

choice_prompt:2:1422692001.text: Did it work? She's not regenerating...

say:4:1422692002:1.text: The Ivory Tree... the Deer Spirit... I can feel them. They're overjoyed...
say:4:1422692002:1.source_cn: 嗯，我能感到皎月树的气息，还有鹿灵，那样喜悦……

say:5:1422692004:1.text: It's granted me memories... from Misarte herself.
say:5:1422692004:1.source_cn: 鹿灵……已经将所有的过去传达给我了。

say:6:1422692005:1.text: Back then... the Hypogean had already infected the Sylvan Egg. Purification was impossible.
say:6:1422692005:1.source_cn: 当年……弥萨忒面临着两难抉择——恶魔已经寄生于翡绿之卵...

say:7:1422692006:1.text: To cut away the corruption, she had to tear out a piece of her own divine power.
say:7:1422692006:1.source_cn: 而一旦剥离被污染的部分，也意味着要分离祂的神力。

say:8:1422692007:1.text: So she created this hidden space, sealing Saida's core body here, and hoped the Ivory Tree's power could slowly purify it.
say:8:1422692007:1.source_cn: 于是，弥萨忒创造了这一空间，将恶魔悉达的本体镇压于此，...

say:9:1422692008:1.text: The rest of the corrupted fragment... it traveled with the Sylvan Tendril to Sal'thorin, alongside my ancestors.
say:9:1422692008:1.source_cn: 而另一部分……则随着织叶和我的先祖们前往了萨洛克兰。

say:10:1422692009:1.text: No wonder Misarte was so furious... This Hypogean has been a threat for two thousand years.
say:10:1422692009:1.source_cn: 这样棘手的恶魔，难怪弥萨忒如此震怒……

say:11:1422692010:1.text: Misarte likely believed that dividing and sealing her in two halves would weaken her enough to keep her contained.
say:11:1422692010:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒可能认为，将恶魔分割成两部分，分别镇压，会使其力...

say:13:1422692011:1.text: But she underestimated the nature of a parasite, never anticipated... that even split, Saida could slowly regain strength in both places.
say:13:1422692011:1.source_cn: 但祂没料到这恶魔即使分裂，也能在两地缓慢恢复力量。

say:14:1422692012:1.text: Misarte had no other choice. If the Hypogean fully merged with the Sylvan Egg, the whole of Vaduso would've been destroyed.
say:14:1422692012:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒当时别无选择。如果恶魔彻底融入翡绿之卵，整个瓦度...

say:15:1422692013:1.text: Separation was the only way forward. But the price was immense.
say:15:1422692013:1.source_cn: 分离是唯一的选择，尽管代价沉重。

say:16:1422692014:0.text: There was one thing Misarte overlooked—a parasite can silently influence the host's will. Whispers here, seeds there... until the host doesn't even know they're compromised.
say:16:1422692014:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒还忽略了一件事——寄生者能够悄无声息地影响宿主的意志。

say:17:1422692015:0.text: Saida's influence and the cursed punishment slowly poisoned the minds of the Essail.
say:17:1422692015:0.source_cn: 恶魔悉达的暗示，以及诅咒的惩罚，让艾塞勒们迷失了心智。

say:18:1422692016:0.text: Is that why Seralyth became so obsessed? Saida was even able to hide a part of her within the Eclipsion...
say:18:1422692016:0.source_cn: 所以……奈萨雷斯才会如此偏执吗？后来，她的一部分又躲入...

choice_prompt:19:1422692016.text: Is that why Seralyth became so obsessed? Saida was even able to hide a part of her within the Eclipsion...
choice_prompt:19:1422692016.source_cn: 所以……奈萨雷斯才会如此偏执吗？后来，她的一部分又躲入了杜恩加尔……

say:20:1422692017:0.text: The Hypogean preyed on all their despair. Turned their grief into a path for her own return, luring them into even darker paths...
say:20:1422692017:0.source_cn: 正是。恶魔利用艾塞勒们对诅咒的绝望，引导他们走向了更加...

say:21:1422692018:1.text: So... they weren't punished for defying the goddess or joining the war... but because they unknowingly brought a Hypogean back to the Dark Forest, and gave her the perfect host...
say:21:1422692018:1.source_cn: 原来，违背神意参战并非根本原因……而是因为他们无意中将...

say:22:1422692019:0.text: Misarte's judgment was meant to protect all other life. But a two-thousand-year curse... it's still a cruel fate.
say:22:1422692019:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒的惩戒是在保护其他生灵。但两千年的诅咒——还是过...

say:23:1422692020:1.text: I believe Misarte's true intention was never to punish you forever. She was waiting... waiting until Saida could be utterly destroyed.
say:23:1422692020:1.source_cn: 我想，弥萨忒的真意并非永远惩罚你们，祂只是在等待恶魔悉...

say:24:1422692021:1.text: Then... this was our true trial. Our redemption.
say:24:1422692021:1.source_cn: 所以，击败恶魔悉达才是我们真正的使命和救赎之路？

say:25:1422692022:0.text: Yes. Now you may tell your people that the Essail curse can finally be lifted.
say:25:1422692022:0.source_cn: 是的。现在，你可以告诉你的族人，艾塞勒的诅咒已经可以被...

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 或许绝望才是恶魔悉达的养分……

say:27:1422692003:1.text: As expected of Merlin. Such a perfect seal. I can sense it... The Deer Spirit believes this place has been sanctified again.
say:27:1422692003:1.source_cn: 不愧是梅林，封印得如此彻底，我能感应到，鹿灵认为此处已...
say:27:1422692003:1.male: As expected of Merlin. Such a perfect seal. I can sense it... The Deer Spirit believes this place has been sanctified again.
say:27:1422692003:1.female: As expected of Merlin. Such a perfect seal. I can sense it... The Deer Spirit believes this place has been sanctified again.
